value.data: 30-day implied volatility from Vyreon's American option surface (VS-IVS01): every call and put quote on every strike is priced with an American model (early exercise, projected cash dividends, the Treasury bill curve plus the day's options-implied financing spread), the day's smile is fitted across expiries, and the at-the-money volatility is read at 30 calendar days in total variance. Published with its calibrated standard error whenever the fit yields one, however wide (D-095: no threshold for now; thin option markets show wide errors). Not VIX and not the provider's IV.
